bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
candidate="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:invite-copy-f62d8c3d)" || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")" = "$candidate" || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 65
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 65
cd "$repo"
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null || exit 66
row="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||message_id FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' AND state='needs_reconcile';")"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$row" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 74
IFS='|' read -r chat message <<< "$row"
case "$chat" in -1003847210571|-1002373696859|-1003770334893) ;; *) exit 74;; esac
case "$message" in ''|*[!0-9]*)exit 74;; esac
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py room_public_readback --chat-id "$chat" --message-id "$message" >/dev/null || exit 76
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null || exit 66
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 65
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 65
echo UNRECONCILED_MESSAGE_BOT_OWNERSHIP=PASS
echo NO_MUTATION=YES
echo USERBOT_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
